title: 貨運編組場駝峰調速
summary: 本課聚焦以能量與事件時序理解貨運駝峰調速。從坡高與重力能量帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把速度資料年齡與位移與區段軸數與未知狀態連成可驗證的介面，最後以載重與環境試驗邊界整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies energy accounting and event timing in hump-yard speed control. Start with height drop and gravitational energy to define physical or information boundaries, connect data age and continued wagon movement with section axle balance and unknown state as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through load and environment coverage. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 坡高與重力能量帳與動能差與平均耗能力
stages.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy & Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「坡高與重力能量帳」與「動能差與平均耗能力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Height drop and gravitational energy" and "Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 坡高與重力能量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡高與重力能量帳」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Height drop and gravitational energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。比較不同質量的原創案例，避免只用坡高猜測到達速度。位能下降可轉成動能與耗散，質量同時影響可用能量和需要消散的能量。駝峰調速的速度結果還受滾動阻力、風與車輛狀態影響；只用高度差決定目標速度會漏掉路徑上的持續損失與偶發阻力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡高與重力能量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. Compare hypothetical wagon masses without predicting arrival speed from height alone. Lost gravitational energy becomes kinetic energy and dissipation. Mass affects both available and required dissipated energy. Hump-yard speed also depends on rolling resistance, wind and vehicle condition. Height drop alone cannot determine final speed without accounting for losses along the path. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Height drop and gravitational energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡高與重力能量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Height drop and gravitational energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 坡高與重力能量帳
knowledge.text: 先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。比較不同質量的原創案例，避免只用坡高猜測到達速度。
knowledge.textEn: Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. Compare hypothetical wagon masses without predicting arrival speed from height alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「坡高與重力能量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Height drop and gravitational energy" is correct?
options: 下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度
先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。
耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同
optionsEn: Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons.
Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route.
Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed.
quiz.explanation: 先畫出車輛質心高度的起訖位置，將可用位能與沿途阻力損失分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark initial and final centre-of-mass heights and separate available potential energy from losses along the route. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 坡高與重力能量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡高與重力能量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Height drop and gravitational energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。公式 y=m*g*h/1000，代入得 y=824.04 kJ。邊界：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m. Formula y=m*g*h/1000 gives y=824.04 kJ. Boundary: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a scale incline to compare final speeds at equal drop but different resistance, recording the energy difference rather than merely motion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。公式 y=m*g*h/1000，代入得 y=824.04 kJ。邊界：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「坡高與重力能量帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Height drop and gravitational energy", which statement holds?
options: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。
optionsEn: A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；下降高度 h=1.2 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; vertical drop h=1.2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 坡高與重力能量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡高與重力能量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Height drop and gravitational energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。以「坡高與重力能量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a scale incline to compare final speeds at equal drop but different resistance, recording the energy difference rather than merely motion. For height drop and gravitational energy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把下降高度 h 從 1.2 改成 1.32 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 824.04 變為 906.444 kJ。先說明「坡高與重力能量帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only vertical drop h from 1.2 to 1.32 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 824.04 to 906.444 kJ. Explain the causal direction for height drop and gravitational energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low-resistance wagon can exceed the predicted speed, while increased bearing resistance can stop it early; average mass cannot distinguish either condition. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。以「坡高與重力能量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For height drop and gravitational energy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Explain the causal direction for height drop and gravitational energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「坡高與重力能量帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Height drop and gravitational energy"?
options: 以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
optionsEn: Use a scale incline to compare final speeds at equal drop but different resistance, recording the energy difference rather than merely motion.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
quiz.explanation: 以縮尺斜面比較同高度與不同阻力表面的末速，記錄能量差而非只看是否滑動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a scale incline to compare final speeds at equal drop but different resistance, recording the energy difference rather than merely motion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 坡高與重力能量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Height drop and gravitational energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡高與重力能量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Height drop and gravitational energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。回到「坡高與重力能量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low-resistance wagon can exceed the predicted speed, while increased bearing resistance can stop it early; average mass cannot distinguish either condition. Trace the input chain for height drop and gravitational energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：重力位能帳，未計真實場站阻力、風與調速設備控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Gravitational energy accounting without real yard resistance, wind or retarder control.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「下降高度一樣就能保證所有貨車得到相同末速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal height drop guarantees equal final speed for all freight wagons." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。回到「坡高與重力能量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A low-resistance wagon can exceed the predicted speed, while increased bearing resistance can stop it early; average mass cannot distinguish either condition. Trace the input chain for height drop and gravitational energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡高與重力能量帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Height drop and gravitational energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。
耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A low-resistance wagon can exceed the predicted speed, while increased bearing resistance can stop it early; average mass cannot distinguish either condition.
Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed.
quiz.explanation: 低阻車輛可能比預測更快，輪軸阻力增加則可能停在途中，兩者都不能靠平均車重辨認。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low-resistance wagon can exceed the predicted speed, while increased bearing resistance can stop it early; average mass cannot distinguish either condition. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 動能差與平均耗能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「動能差與平均耗能力」如何影響貨運編組場駝峰調速的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hump-yard speed-control systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把入口與出口速度各自平方後建立能量差，觀察入口速度小幅偏差的放大效果。再把平均力與沿程峰值區分，不能從一個平均量推論接觸力分布。所需平均耗能力可由動能差除以作用距離估算，初速平方使高速偏差特別敏感。平均力不是峰值力，也不會描述濕滑、延遲和接觸分布；調速結果必須同時檢查能量帳、末速與沿程減速度。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動能差與平均耗能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error. Distinguish mean force from local peaks instead of inferring the contact distribution from one average. Required mean dissipating force follows kinetic-energy change divided by distance, making high initial-speed errors particularly influential. Mean force is not peak force and does not describe wet contact, delay or force distribution. Verification needs energy, exit speed and deceleration along the path together. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「動能差與平均耗能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 動能差與平均耗能力
knowledge.titleEn: Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force
knowledge.text: 把入口與出口速度各自平方後建立能量差，觀察入口速度小幅偏差的放大效果。再把平均力與沿程峰值區分，不能從一個平均量推論接觸力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error. Distinguish mean force from local peaks instead of inferring the contact distribution from one average.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「動能差與平均耗能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force" is correct?
options: 耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
把入口與出口速度各自平方後建立能量差，觀察入口速度小幅偏差的放大效果。
optionsEn: Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error.
quiz.explanation: 把入口與出口速度各自平方後建立能量差，觀察入口速度小幅偏差的放大效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use squared entry and exit speeds to obtain the energy change and observe sensitivity to entry-speed error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 動能差與平均耗能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動能差與平均耗能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。公式 y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000，代入得 y=40.8333 kN。邊界：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m. Formula y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000 gives y=40.8333 kN. Boundary: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In an offline model, compare integrated energy with exit speed and vary contact delay and effective length independently.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。公式 y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000，代入得 y=40.8333 kN。邊界：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m. Formula y=0.5*m*(v0*v0-v1*v1)/length/1000 gives y=40.8333 kN. Boundary: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「動能差與平均耗能力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。
短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確
進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m.
Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.
Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：車輛質量 m=70000 kg；初速 v0=5 m/s；末速 v1=2 m/s；耗能距離 length=18 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vehicle mass m=70000 kg; initial speed v0=5 m/s; final speed v1=2 m/s; dissipation distance length=18 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 動能差與平均耗能力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動能差與平均耗能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。以「動能差與平均耗能力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In an offline model, compare integrated energy with exit speed and vary contact delay and effective length independently. For kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v0 從 5 改成 5.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40.8333 變為 51.0417 kN。先說明「動能差與平均耗能力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v0 from 5 to 5.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 40.8333 to 51.0417 kN. Explain the causal direction for kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：作用延遲縮短有效距離時，即使平均接觸力沒變也可能留下過高末速；速度感測偏差會誤導診斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Delayed action shortens effective distance and raises exit speed despite unchanged contact force; biased speed sensing can obscure the cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。以「動能差與平均耗能力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把初速 v0 從 5 改成 5.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40.8333 變為 51.0417 kN。先說明「動能差與平均耗能力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「動能差與平均耗能力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
In an offline model, compare integrated energy with exit speed and vary contact delay and effective length independently.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 在離線模型比較能量積分與末速度，將接觸延遲及作用長度誤差各自改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In an offline model, compare integrated energy with exit speed and vary contact delay and effective length independently. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 動能差與平均耗能力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動能差與平均耗能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 作用延遲縮短有效距離時，即使平均接觸力沒變也可能留下過高末速；速度感測偏差會誤導診斷。回到「動能差與平均耗能力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Delayed action shortens effective distance and raises exit speed despite unchanged contact force; biased speed sensing can obscure the cause. Trace the input chain for kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路徑與定等效耗能，不包含實際編組場操作參數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level path and constant equivalent dissipation, without real hump-yard operating settings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「耗能設備平均力相同就能保證所有進入速度的末速相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal mean retarding force gives the same exit speed for every entry speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 作用延遲縮短有效距離時，即使平均接觸力沒變也可能留下過高末速；速度感測偏差會誤導診斷。回到「動能差與平均耗能力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Delayed action shortens effective distance and raises exit speed despite unchanged contact force; biased speed sensing can obscure the cause. Trace the input chain for kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「動能差與平均耗能力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Kinetic-energy change and mean retarding force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
作用延遲縮短有效距離時，即使平均接觸力沒變也可能留下過高末速；速度感測偏差會誤導診斷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
Delayed action shortens effective distance and raises exit speed despite unchanged contact force; biased speed sensing can obscure the cause.
quiz.explanation: 作用延遲縮短有效距離時，即使平均接觸力沒變也可能留下過高末速；速度感測偏差會誤導診斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Delayed action shortens effective distance and raises exit speed despite unchanged contact force; biased speed sensing can obscure the cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
